outlet: Whitman County Gazette, 'Colton and Endicott levies' (Teresa Simpson, 2025-10-16)
notes: Paywalled excerpt: Colton Proposition No. 872 (2025) was a $30,000 excess levy, an estimated $0.71 per $1,000, to continue support for general operations, streets and water/sewer; Endicott had three levies on the 2025 ballot.
